radius.$description: Round corners of the timeline marker.

icon-size.$description: Size of the decorative glyph inside the timeline marker.

bg.$description: Fill of the neutral timeline marker.

fg.$description: Glyph color on the neutral timeline marker.

bg-image.$description: Optional decorative image over the timeline marker fill.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter behind a timeline marker, off by default.

bg.$description: Fill of the primary timeline marker.

fg.$description: Glyph color on the primary timeline marker.

bg.$description: Fill of the success timeline marker.

fg.$description: Glyph color on the success timeline marker.

bg.$description: Fill of the warning timeline marker.

fg.$description: Glyph color on the warning timeline marker.

bg.$description: Fill of the danger timeline marker.

fg.$description: Glyph color on the danger timeline marker.

line.$description: Color of the decorative line connecting timeline markers.

line-width.$description: Hairline width of the timeline connector.

time-bg.$description: The timestamp shows the surrounding surface through its transparent background.

time-fg.$description: Text color of the timeline timestamp.

gap.$description: Space between marker and text and between timeline entries.

fg.$description: Text color of the event summary and details.
